source_text:
11.1 Σῶσόν με, Κύριε, ο τι ἐκλέλοιπεν ο σιος, ο τι
ὠλιγώθησαν αἱ ἀλήθειαι ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων. ̓Επειδὴ κινδυνεύει τῆς
ἀληθείας ἀπεσ βεσθῆναι τὸ χάρισμα, οἱ μὲν ο σιοι ἐκλελοί πασιν, αἱ δὲ ἀλήθειαι
ὠλιγώθησαν· οὐκ ἐν τοῖς ὁσίοις μόνοις αἱ ἀλήθειαι, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀληθέσιν ἡ ὁσιότης.
Η ἐπειδὴ οἱ ο σιοι ἐκ λελοίπασιν, διὰ τοῦτο ὠλιγώθησαν αἱ ἀλή θειαι· καὶ τάχα ἡ
σπάνις τῶν ὁσίων αἰτία γέγονε τῶν πολλῶν αἱρέσεων.
pass_a_gloss: Save me, Lord, because has-failed a-holy-one, because have-been-diminished the truths from the sons of-the men. Because is-in-danger of-the truth to-be-extinguished the gift, the on-the-one-hand holy-ones have-failed, the on-the-other-hand truths have-been-diminished; not in the holy-ones only the truths, and in the true-ones the holiness. Or because the holy-ones have-failed, through this have-been-diminished the truths; and perhaps the scarcity of-the holy-ones cause has-become of-the many heresies.
pass_b_english: “Save me, Lord, because a holy one has failed, because the truths have been diminished from the sons of men” (Psalm 11:1).

Because the gift of the truth is in danger of being extinguished, the holy ones have failed, and the truths have been diminished; the truths are not in the holy ones only, and holiness is also in those who are true.
Or because the holy ones have failed, for this reason the truths have been diminished; and perhaps the scarcity of the holy ones has become the cause of the many heresies.

choices.why: OCR ο σιος is ὅσιος, not ἅγιος. Singular in the lemma; comment then uses the plural ὅσιοι.
rejected: holy ones as the lemma subject

choices.term: κινδυνεύει τῆς ἀληθείας ἀποσβεσθῆναι τὸ χάρισμα
choices.english: the gift of the truth is in danger of being extinguished
choices.why: κινδυνεύει + aorist infinitive ἀποσβεσθῆναι. Not ‘endangers to be lost’.
rejected: the gift of truth endangers to be lost

choices.why: Second explanation after the first. OCR Η is ἤ, not γάρ.

choices.term: σπάνις τῶν ὁσίων αἰτία γέγονε τῶν πολλῶν αἱρέσεων
choices.english: the scarcity of the holy ones has become the cause of the many heresies

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
